name: Wizard Tycoon - 2 Player
desc:
2 Player Wizard Tycoon! Work together to become the most powerful wizards! Unlocking staffs, potions and brooms along the way. Defeat foes or make friends, it's up to you.

Stand still and your forcefield will not disappear. 

UPDATE 05/2026:
Fixed flying gamepads issues
Fixed ninja potion, gravity disruptor, decoy deploy potions
Fixed lightning staff

+ More coming soon!

----- CONTROLS
- Hold W on PC to fly brooms
- Move thumbstick forward on mobile to fly brooms

Please let me know any bugs!
